Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Create a CloudFormation template provisioning an AWS Lambda function named 'order-processor' triggered by an SQS queue, written in Python 3.12.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Lambda order-processor triggered by SQS with best-practice security and reliability.

Parameters:
  CodeS3Bucket:
    Type: String
    Description: S3 bucket containing the Lambda deployment package.
  CodeS3Key:
    Type: String
    Description: S3 key for the Lambda deployment package.
  CodeS3ObjectVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional S3 object version for the Lambda deployment package.
  LambdaMemorySize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 256
    Description: Memory size (MB) for the Lambda function.
  LambdaTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: Timeout (seconds) for the Lambda function.
  LambdaReservedConcurrency:
    Type: Number
    Default: 10
    Description: Reserved concurrency for the Lambda function.
  ESMMaxConcurrency:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    Description: Maximum concurrent batches for the SQS event source mapping.
  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: CloudWatch Logs retention in days.
  QueueVisibilityTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 180
    Description: Visibility timeout (seconds) for the SQS queue.

Conditions:
  HasCodeObjectVersion: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CodeS3ObjectVersion, '']]

Resources:
  OrdersDLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: true
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      RedriveAllowPolicy:
        redrivePermission: byQueue
        sourceQueueArns:
          - !GetAtt OrdersQueue.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: order-processor

  OrdersQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: true
      VisibilityTimeout: !Ref QueueVisibilityTimeout
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt OrdersDLQ.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: order-processor

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: LogsWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/order-processor:*
        - PolicyName: SQSPollPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SQSPollSpecificQueue
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:ReceiveMessage
                  - sqs:DeleteMessage
                  - sqs:ChangeMessageVisibility
                  - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                Resource: !GetAtt OrdersQueue.Arn
              - Sid: SQSGetQueueUrl
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:GetQueueUrl
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: order-processor

  OrderProcessorFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: order-processor
      Description: Processes order messages from SQS.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: app.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        S3Bucket: !Ref CodeS3Bucket
        S3Key: !Ref CodeS3Key
        S3ObjectVersion: !If [HasCodeObjectVersion, !Ref CodeS3ObjectVersion, !Ref AWS::NoValue]
      MemorySize: !Ref LambdaMemorySize
      Timeout: !Ref LambdaTimeout
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      ReservedConcurrentExecutions: !Ref LambdaReservedConcurrency
      Environment:
        Variables:
          LOG_LEVEL: INFO
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: order-processor

  OrderProcessorLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/order-processor
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: order-processor

  OrdersQueueEventSourceMapping:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::EventSourceMapping
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref OrderProcessorFunction
      EventSourceArn: !GetAtt OrdersQueue.Arn
      BatchSize: 10
      MaximumBatchingWindowInSeconds: 5
      Enabled: true
      ScalingConfig:
        MaximumConcurrency: !Ref ESMMaxConcurrency
      FunctionResponseTypes:
        - ReportBatchItemFailures

Outputs:
  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the order-processor Lambda function.
    Value: !GetAtt OrderProcessorFunction.Arn
  OrdersQueueUrl:
    Description: URL of the SQS queue that triggers the Lambda function.
    Value: !Ref OrdersQueue
  OrdersDLQUrl:
    Description: URL of the Dead Letter Queue.
    Value: !Ref OrdersDLQ
